title: Subtraction within 10: Separating
standard_text: K.3A model the action of joining to represent addition and the action of separating to represent subtraction; K.3B solve word problems using objects and drawings to find sums up to 10 and differences within 10
meta_desc: Free kindergarten subtraction worksheets for Texas TEKS K.3A and K.3B: take away, ten frames, number lines, number sentences and stories within 10. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Subtracting means separating or taking away.
  • Cross out the ones that go away. Count the ones that are left.
  • Write it as a number sentence: 7 − 3 = 4.

Examples

Example

7 birds. 3 fly away.

Cross out 3

Count what is left

Answer: 4 birds

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting the crossed-out onesCount only the ones left.
Adding insteadGo away means take away.
Being off by 1Count back one hop at a time.
